items.summary_en: Colo Colo's new player Vozinha will make his debut soon. His first game will be broadcast in Argentina, Brazil and Mexico. TNT Sports confirmed the news.

items.title_en: Vozinha's Colo Colo debut to air in Argentina, Brazil and Mexico

items.raw_excerpt: Casa da Leitura Franco Giglio, no Bigorrilho, voltou a integrar a rede de bibliotecas de bairro de Curitiba nesta quinta-feira (6/8), após passar por restauro e ampliação
items.summary_en: Casa da Leitura Franco Giglio rejoined Curitiba's neighborhood library network on Thursday after restoration and expansion. The mayor spoke at the reopening and said reading helped Curitiba win the Ideb. The library is in the Bigorrilho neighborhood.
items.summary_ko: 카사 다 레이투라 프랑코 질리오 도서관이 보수와 확장 공사를 마친 뒤 목요일 쿠리치바 동네 도서관 목록에 다시 합류했습니다. 시장은 재개관식에서 독서가 쿠리치바가 이데브를 따는 데 도움이 됐다고 말했습니다. 이 도서관은 빅고릴료 동네에 있습니다.
items.title_en: Neighborhood library reopens in Curitiba after renovation
items.title_ko: 쿠리치바 동네 도서관이 보수 공사를 마치고 다시 문을 열었어요
items.title_original: Leitura ajudou Curitiba na conquista do Ideb, diz prefeito na reabertura de espaço literário em Curitiba - Prefeitura de Curitiba

items.raw_excerpt: Modern Erratics, Saskatoon's new $297,490 permanent public art installation, consists of three boulder-sized sculptures made of recycled plastic and placed throughout the city. Reviews are mixed.
items.summary_en: Saskatoon spent $297,490 on a public art project called Modern Erratics. It placed three boulder-sized sculptures made of recycled plastic around the city. Some people mock the art, while others defend it.

items.title_en: City puts plastic boulders around Saskatoon, reviews are mixed

items.title_original: Rock 'n' roil: Some mock, others defend public art project that put 3 plastic boulders around Saskatoon

items.raw_excerpt: Northern Marianas tennis player Carol Young Suh Lee has upset the top seed at the Warsaw Open in Poland on her way to the tournament's quarterfinals.
items.summary_en: Carol Young Suh Lee from the Northern Marianas beat the top seed at the Warsaw Open in Poland. She is now in the quarterfinals of the tournament.

items.raw_excerpt: It's a shock and a disappointment that Kaitāia's Northland Mill will close down today - two weeks ahead of schedule, a union organiser says.
items.summary_en: A factory in the small town of Kaitaia is closing down today, two weeks ahead of schedule. A union organiser says the news is a shock and a disappointment.

items.raw_excerpt: Tucked away in northwestern Ontario’s wilderness, there’s a hidden gem castle with a fascinating origin story. Here’s what to know about White Otter Castle.
items.summary_en: White Otter Castle is a hidden log castle deep in the wilderness of northwestern Ontario. One man built it alone by hand over many years. Today people travel to see this strange and charming landmark.
items.summary_ko: 화이트 오터 성은 온타리오 북서부 황야 깊숙이 숨겨진 통나무 성입니다. 한 남자가 오랜 세월 혼자 손수 지은 곳입니다. 오늘날에는 사람들이 꼭 보고 가는 재미있고 정겨운 명소가 되었습니다.
items.title_en: The hidden story of a wilderness castle in a small Ontario town
